title: The Morning Where Numbers Remember They Were Dreaming

features.name: waking registers
features.desc-on-touch: You find numbered ledgers open to their final pages. The last entry reads forward and backward the same. Each row a count; each count a moment between sleep and waking.

features.name: score fragments
features.desc-on-touch: Scattered notation. The measures number themselves. Whether it's a musical phrase or an astronomical sequence, the boundary has become uncertain.

features.name: dream-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water so still it holds the reflection of numbers. When you look directly at them, they dissolve. When you look away, they return.

features.name: dawn-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A character that could mean 'waking' or 'counting' or 'the number at which dreaming ends.' It's inscribed in frost-pattern, already melting.

inscription: the sum climbs back into sleep as the light learns to count

file.name: PatriciaStockdill_OperaScoreFragment_HunterValley.mp3
file.note: A single aria from 'The Red Return,' numbered by the listener's breath count instead of conventional timing. Recording corrupts slightly at each playback—the peaks shift as if still dreaming.
